responsibility: Implements the GNU Modula-2 GCC plugin pass that tracks calls to Modula-2 runtime exception handlers and determines whether they are reachable from the first basic block of compiled functions. It defines the plugin pass, registers it after late gimple optimizations, scans each function’s gimple statements to classify direct calls as runtime exceptions, constructors/deconstructors, extern-visible functions, or ordinary calls, and feeds that information into the `rtegraph` analysis structures. At `PLUGIN_FINISH`, it runs graph discovery and cleanup to report or record inevitable runtime-exception paths across reachable functions.
